indicator_name: IFRS balance sheets of state development institutions (Baiterek, Development Bank of Kazakhstan, Kazakhstan Sustainability Fund, Agrarian Credit Corporation)
description: Балансы институтов развития по МСФО (Байтерек, Банк развития Казахстана, Казахстанский фонд устойчивости, Аграрная кредитная корпорация)
methodology: Balance-sheet lines of the quarterly and annual IFRS statements on KASE, dated at the balance-sheet date (quarter end); the latest statement wins when two give the same date (restatements). Item ISSUER.LINE: TOTAL_ASSETS, TOTAL_LIABILITIES, EQUITY (only columns with assets = liabilities + equity within 0.5% are kept), LOANS_CUSTOMERS, LOANS_BANKS, FIN_LEASE, DEBT_SECURITIES, GOV_LOANS, PARENT_LOANS, GOV_SUBSIDIES (deferred income from below-market state funding), CUSTOMER_FUNDS. Coverage: BRKZ from 2013-12, AGKK from 2013-12 (separate statements to 2021, consolidated from 2022 -- a break), BTRK from 2018-12, KFUS from 2020-12; quarters the issuer did not file in xlsx are missing (BTRK has no June statement 2020-2024). BTRK consolidates BRKZ, AGKK (via KazAgro since 2021), Damu and Otbasy bank, so do not add issuers.
